info.name: Inside API
info.description:
NestJS Phase 2 API for Inside (interior design marketplace).

1. Select environment **Inside Local**
2. Run **01 Auth → Login (seed client)** (or designer/admin)
3. `accessToken` is saved automatically for Bearer auth
4. Fill collection variables (`requestId`, `projectId`, etc.) from responses

Auth: Bearer JWT (not cookies). Swagger: {{baseUrl}}/api/docs

request.description: Seed users: client@ / designer@ / admin@inside.test — Password123!
Use designer token. Switch between CLIENT and DESIGNER.
